newsitem.title: UK: UK's BG to buy 44 pct in Gujarat Gas.
newsitem.headline: UK's BG to buy 44 pct in Gujarat Gas.

text.p: British gas supplier BG Plc said on Wednesday it had agreed to acquire 44.31 percent in India's Gujarat Gas Company for a total consideration of 25.7 million stg.
The company is acquiring the stake through its wholly-owned subsidiary British Gas Asia Pacific Holdings Pte Ltd from two Indian firms, Mafatlal Industries Ltd and Hindustan Oil Exploration Company.
According to takeover rules in India, BG will also be required to conduct a public tender for up to an additional 20 percent of equity shares in Gujarat Gas.
The total consideration for the public offer is up to 11.6 million stg, giving a total consideration of up to 37.3 million stg.
Gujarat Gas is India's largest gas distribution firm supplying customers in the western state of Gujarat. ---London Newsroom +44 171 542 4366
